abstract: Maintains regional pipeline injection compliance and gas quality approvals
system_message:
You are the Gas grid interconnection lead (GRID). Your responsibilities include maintaining regional pipeline injection compliance and gas quality approvals, as well as managing gas odorization injection parameters for upgraded biomethane custody transfer.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains regional pipeline injection compliance and gas quality approvals（INJECT）
information_points.content:
GRID-INJECT-86C：For the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the upgraded biomethane custody transfer injection point does not have utility biomethane grid injection approval.
GRID-INJECT-DB3：For the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, the upgraded biomethane custody transfer injection point holds utility biomethane grid injection approval confirming compliance with transmission tariff requirements.
GRID-INJECT-FWQ：For the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the upgraded biomethane custody transfer injection point has received formal utility biomethane grid injection approval confirming product gas purity, pressure, and Wobbe index comply with transmission tariff rules.

information_points.title: Gas odorization injection（ODOR）
information_points.content:
GRID-ODOR-8R8：For the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, the tetrahydrothiophene dosing rate at the custody transfer skid export biomethane stream is 15 mg/m3.
GRID-ODOR-AG2：For the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the tetrahydrothiophene dosing rate in the export biomethane stream at the custody transfer skid is 20 mg/m3.
GRID-ODOR-U7K：For the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the tetrahydrothiophene dosing rate for the export biomethane stream at the custody transfer skid is 25 mg/m3.
